boundary: Exact bounded advisory turn context only. Original-basis branching, action previews/commands, missing native examiners and connected graph cycles remain their own required A1 items. Work inputs/proposals/output and inquiry framing/source bytes are explicitly withheld on metadata paths; no fact, approval, examination, resolved inquiry or completed domain work is inferred.

findings.finding: Content-hash-only graph joins allowed equal-content different definition identities or revisions to enter as the current basis.
findings.resolution: All graph/overlay/working joins now compare exact identity/revision/hash and Project scope; changed identities/revisions and mixed views are denied.

findings.finding: Native content could remain disclosed after its material basis became stale, and no final Project fence or post-recovery permission check stopped assembly-time drift/revocation.
findings.resolution: Stale native bytes are withheld. Final Project/definition/objective/authority and permission checks run before retaining/invoking; tests assert no runtime start on drift or revocation.

findings.finding: A full shell definition copied all terms inside definition_ref, defeating entry omissions and rejecting legitimate large definitions. The critical test originally failed to include the real shell terminology projection.
findings.resolution: The definition reference now contains only immutable ID/revision/hash/family; all terms use the bounded whole-entry excerpt. The corrected test preserves full shell terminology and checks exact omitted/included counts under the actual byte budget.
